name: Color Swatch
purpose: Preview one color or a compact mix of colors with a finished alpha-aware visual treatment and closed shape recipes.
useWhen: A selected, available, saved, or documented color needs a compact visual preview.

avoidWhen.condition: The user must choose or edit a color.

composition: Render Root for one color and Mix for two or more colors.
Choose sharp, rounded, or circle through shape rather than application border-radius CSS.
Place the passive swatch inside its owning control when it represents a selectable option.

rules.statement: Do not use the swatch as the only carrier of a color name, selection state, validation state, or action.
Leave decorative swatches unlabeled, or provide label when the swatch itself must be exposed as an image.
Use the closed shape prop for sharp, rounded, or circle geometry before overriding the public radius variable.
Load styles.css or core.css plus color-swatch.css.

commonMistakes.mistake: Adding click handlers directly to ColorSwatch.
commonMistakes.correction: Place the passive swatch inside Button, Color Picker SwatchTrigger, or another semantic control.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using custom border-radius CSS for a standard square or circle.

validation: Check solid, alpha, mixed, size, all three shapes, light/dark, forced colors, zoom, RTL, and decorative versus labeled semantics.
